p79_9.root_cause: client inferred authorization from scope/type/expire instead of consuming server-calculated access_level/permissions, so an already-activated UDID could still be treated as unactivated and receive a card prompt

p79_10.name: server_authoritative_access_model

authorization_contract.rule: client must not infer card type from scope/type/expire

startup_contract: query /apiface by UDID before reading or requesting a card
if access_level is global_plus, app_plus or basic, continue Runtime Config + Verify without card prompt
only when the server returns no usable authorization/block/missing access level does the activation card prompt appear
network/5xx lookup failure must not be treated as no authorization
device_verification_required: fresh App + already-activated UDID returns access_level and does not show card prompt
app_plus proceeds directly to Verify and Verify decides current-App applicability
lookup failure does not show card prompt
first card activation is re-read through /apiface and accepted only from server access_level

secret_storage_policy: test/real Verify Secret is injected only into the controlled final artifact and is not committed to public Git history
next_task: Install the controlled v1_p79_10 Secret-configured dylib and verify that an already-activated UDID on a newly installed App bypasses the card prompt based on server access_level.
